# Dr. Niranjan Ghag — Orthopaedic Surgeon, Thane

> Orthopaedic surgeon in Thane West, Maharashtra, specialising in robotic-assisted
> hip & knee replacement, foot & ankle surgery, sports injuries & arthroscopy, and
> complex trauma & fracture management. Consultations in English, Marathi and Hindi.

Dr. Niranjan Ghag (alternate name: Dr. Niranjan Sunil Ghag) consults at four Thane West
locations. He considers non-surgical treatment first wherever it is reasonable.

## Contact, locations & OPD hours
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 90760 79000 (alternate: +91 90294 70134)
- Joshi's Neurotrauma Centre, Khopat, Thane West (opposite Viviana Mall): Mon–Sat 6:00 PM – 8:00 AM; Sunday through the day (call to confirm). The hospital has 24-hour emergency cover.
- Kaizen Super Speciality Hospital, Ramachandra Nagar, Thane West: Mon–Sat 4:00 – 6:00 PM, other times by appointment; Sunday through the day (call to confirm). The hospital has 24-hour emergency cover.
- Borneo Mother and Child Care Hospital, Panch Pakhdi, Thane West: by appointment
- Sahayogi Hospital LLP, Naupada, Thane West: by appointment
- Languages: English, Marathi, Hindi
- Consultation fees are not published on the website; ask when booking.
- Registration: Maharashtra Medical Council Reg. No. 2019/04/2411
- ORCID: https://orcid.org/0009-0004-4161-732X
- Details: https://drniranjanghag.com/contact/
- Location pages: https://drniranjanghag.com/locations/joshis-neurotrauma-centre/ · https://drniranjanghag.com/locations/kaizen-super-speciality-hospital/ · https://drniranjanghag.com/locations/borneo-mother-and-child-care-hospital/ · https://drniranjanghag.com/locations/sahayogi-hospital-llp/
